screenshots.title: Department-aware HR workspace
screenshots.alt: Grand HR dashboard with live team, plantilla, vacancy, and leave metrics
screenshots.capability: Role-aware dashboards combine department metrics, team context, announcements, and workflow links.

screenshots.title: Extensible department dashboards
screenshots.alt: Grand dashboard generated for the Municipal Planning and Development Office
screenshots.capability: A safe generic dashboard automatically supports departments added after deployment.

screenshots.title: Department-centered MSWD workspace
screenshots.alt: Grand MSWD department dashboard with team context, social welfare modules, and a compact assistance summary
screenshots.capability: MSWD staff land in a complete department workspace while Assistance Request Processing remains a focused linked module.

screenshots.title: Social welfare programs and activity operations
screenshots.alt: Grand MSWD programs workspace with active program, upcoming activity, completion, and recorded reach metrics
screenshots.capability: MSWD staff coordinate feeding, seminars, outreach, distributions, schedules, aggregate attendance, and outcome notes with role-based management controls.

screenshots.title: Municipal assistance operations
screenshots.alt: Grand MSWD staff request queue with filters and request status
screenshots.capability: Staff can filter, review, print, and advance assistance requests from one operational queue.

screenshots.title: Permission-controlled citizen review register
screenshots.alt: GRAND MSWD citizen register with review states, request totals, active usage, and last-request dates
screenshots.capability: Authorized MSWD staff can search, sort, and review factual assistance usage while separate permissions control personal information and review decisions.

screenshots.title: Auditable citizen service history
screenshots.alt: GRAND citizen review detail with assistance history, observed identity details, frequency summaries, and human review controls
screenshots.capability: Reviewers can compare submitted identity details, inspect request history, assign review work, and record auditable outcomes without automated risk or eligibility scoring.

screenshots.title: Configurable government reporting workspace
screenshots.alt: GRAND reporting workspace with MSWD report definitions, governance indicators, recurring schedules, recent output states, and permission-aware print and download actions
screenshots.capability: Departments can generate PDF, XLSX, and CSV reports from approved datasets while pilot-versus-official layout validation, controlled templates, schedules, and an idempotent ledger preserve accountability.

screenshots.title: Auditable official report approval
screenshots.alt: GRAND report-run ledger showing archived PDF metadata, print and download actions, checksum, validated template fidelity, audit events, and approved status
screenshots.capability: Every generated report preserves its parameters, versioned print layout, checksum, creator, department fidelity evidence, and review history before it is treated as an official output.

screenshots.title: Familiar forms without brittle automation
screenshots.alt: GRAND controlled template mapping workspace showing Excel named-range rules, successful checksum preflight, and governance guidance
screenshots.capability: Departments can preserve approved Excel or PDF layouts while GRAND restricts data placement to reviewed mappings, records a source checksum, and locks approved versions.

screenshots.title: Governed department records workspace
screenshots.alt: GRAND department records registry with draft, review, official, retention, confidentiality, custodian, and record-type indicators
screenshots.capability: Departments can register operational sources and separate files, enforce restricted visibility, and manage review, approval, retention, legal holds, supersession, and disposition through explicit roles.

screenshots.title: Auditable official record detail
screenshots.alt: GRAND official program record showing its linked operational source, checksum-backed supporting file, approval state, retention controls, and audit history
screenshots.capability: Operational files stay authoritative in their source module while the records ledger preserves typed links, controlled downloads, integrity evidence, lifecycle decisions, and a complete audit trail.

screenshots.title: TracePoint physical-custody workspace
screenshots.alt: GRAND TracePoint workspace showing QR-tagged paper packets, custody status, current responsibility, final destinations, and open discrepancies
screenshots.capability: Departments can find physical paper bundles quickly, see who currently holds them, and distinguish drafts, in-transit work, delivered packets, and exceptions without replacing the underlying report or records systems.

screenshots.title: Voucher-batch custody with repeatable checkpoints
screenshots.alt: GRAND TracePoint packet detail showing individually identified vouchers, repeated Accounting checkpoints, a temporary signature visit, server-timed receipts, and deliberate terminal delivery
screenshots.capability: Bundled vouchers retain stable identities through splits or rebundling, the same office can receive temporarily and later terminally, and every confirmed physical receipt remains immutable and auditable.

screenshots.title: Revocable daily employee QR identity
screenshots.alt: GRAND employee daily-code screen with a time-limited QR, plain-language privacy guidance, replacement, and revocation controls
screenshots.capability: Active employees use random, day-limited QR credentials for physical receipt; GRAND stores only a digest and lets the employee replace or revoke an exposed code immediately.

screenshots.title: Configurable civic service portal
screenshots.alt: GRAND public portal with neutral civic identity, plain-language actions, and official service navigation
screenshots.capability: Authorized administrators can update institutional identity, colors, imagery, media, service labels, icons, links, and ordering without redesigning the portal.

screenshots.title: Resident-friendly responsive access
screenshots.alt: GRAND public service portal adapted to a narrow mobile screen
screenshots.capability: Task-first service guidance and accessible trust cues remain clear on phones used by residents and field staff.

screenshots.title: Account-free citizen assistance
screenshots.alt: Grand public assistance portal with new-request and secure tracking actions
screenshots.capability: Citizens can submit and securely track assistance requests without creating an account.
